description: This file contains a single exported function `shapeStackedSeries` that transforms raw cost records into a dataset suitable for charting with zero-filled stacks, typically for visualization in a dashboard. The function processes records by grouping costs by specified categories and services, and outputs structured data with categories, services, and data points.

methods.name: shapeStackedSeries(records, stackBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms raw cost records into a comma-separated dataset suitable for visualization, with support for sorting, unknown labels, and flexible grouping.
